openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SCOPe REST API
  version: v1
  description: >
    Read-only JSON API for low-cost SCOP/ASTRAL/SCOPe lookups, release-scoped
    hierarchy traversal, indexed search, static-download manifests, and
    paginated collections. Biological data endpoints are release-scoped for
    data selection. Base releases such as 2.08 can receive periodic updates;
    dated selectors do not promise immutable archived snapshots.
    The site's /.well-known/api-catalog provides machine-readable discovery;
    HTTP Link headers advertise the api-catalog and service-desc relations.
servers:
  - url: https://scop.berkeley.edu/api/v1
tags:
  - {name: metadata}
  - {name: search}
  - {name: releases}
  - {name: nodes}
  - {name: pdb}
  - {name: sequences}
  - {name: astral}
  - {name: downloads}
paths:
  /:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getServiceIndex
      summary: Service metadata and canonical endpoint hints
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceIndex'}
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getOpenApiYaml
      summary: OpenAPI document
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /levels:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: listLevels
      summary: SCOP hierarchy levels
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/LevelsResponse'}
  /releases:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: listReleases
      summary: List public SCOP/SCOPe releases
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ReleasesResponse'}
  /releases/current:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getCurrentRelease
      summary: Current public release, including latest periodic update label where applicable
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /releases/{release}:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getRelease
      summary: Public release metadata and current periodic update label
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchCurrentRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in the current release
      description: >
        Uses materialized API search tables. This endpoint does not run broad
        MySQL full-text or leading-wildcard searches. Use it for discovery,
        then fetch exact release-scoped node/PDB endpoints for interpretation.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listCurrentDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for the current release
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/root:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getReleaseRoot
      summary: Root node for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in a specific release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/resolve/{identifier}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: resolveIdentifier
      summary: Resolve a public SCOPe identifier in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - name: identifier

item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q018_tal_effector_repeat_lengths","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, d2kq5a_, d3v6pa_, and d4cj9a_ are all PX/domain entries with the same SCCS, a.298.1.1, because they are homologous TAL-effector repeat arrays, not because the deposited constructs have the same total length. Their lineages converge at family SUNID 267609, TAL (transcription activator-like) effector: d2kq5a_ is PthA from Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. citri, d3v6pa_ is dHax3 from Xanthomonas, and d4cj9a_ is BurrH from Burkholderia rhizoxinica. The sequence records show the scale difference directly: 51, 373, and 752 residues, respectively. SCOPe treats this family as a repeat-family case: the shared unit is a small TAL repeat, represented canonically by BurrH coordinates 4cj9 A:259-292, and the d2kq5a_ and d3v6pa_ annotation carries the repeat inconsistency flag for families whose common domain is built from different numbers of small repeating units. The 4cj9 A:259-292 repeat is therefore a representative repeat segment for family a.298.1.1; it is not a claim that those exact coordinates apply to d2kq5a_ or d3v6pa_. Evolutionarily, the family a.298.1.1 and its parent superfamily a.298.1, TAL effector-like, imply homology, while the parent fold a.298, Left-handed alpha-alpha superhelix, and class a, All alpha proteins, are broader structural/compositional levels and do not add an independent homology assertion. Consequently it is safe to transfer only the family-level TALE-repeat relationship and left-handed alpha-alpha-repeat architecture among these entries; it is unsafe to align the full 51-, 373-, and 752-residue constructs end-to-end, to copy all residue positions or DNA-base contacts from BurrH to PthA/dHax3 by absolute coordinate, or to choose d4cj9a_ as a whole-domain template without first matching the repeat count and register.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d2kq5a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d3v6pa_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d4cj9a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/264989/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/265556/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/265996/parents","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d2kq5a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d3v6pa_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d4cj9a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/264989/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/265556/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/265996/annotations","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267609/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267596/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267589/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456/homology"]}]}
